verses.t: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
verses.pickthall: When the sun is overthrown
verses.yusufAli: When the sun (with its spacious light) is folded up
verses.rodwell: WHEN the sun shall be FOLDED UP
verses.sale: When the sun shall be folded up

verses.t: And when the stars fall, dispersing
verses.pickthall: And when the stars fall
verses.yusufAli: When the stars fall, losing their lustre
verses.rodwell: And when the stars shall fall
verses.sale: and when the stars shall fall

verses.t: And when the mountains are removed
verses.pickthall: And when the hills are moved
verses.yusufAli: When the mountains vanish (like a mirage)
verses.rodwell: And when the mountains shall be set in motion
verses.sale: and when the mountains shall be made to pass away

verses.t: And when full-term she-camels are neglected
verses.pickthall: And when the camels big with young are abandoned
verses.yusufAli: When the she-camels, ten months with young, are left untended
verses.rodwell: And when the she-camels shall be abandoned
verses.sale: and when the camels ten months gone with young shall be neglected

verses.t: And when the wild beasts are gathered
verses.pickthall: And when the wild beasts are herded together
verses.yusufAli: When the wild beasts are herded together (in the human habitations)
verses.rodwell: And when the wild beasts shall be gathered together
verses.sale: and when the wild beasts shall be gathered together

verses.t: And when the seas are filled with flame
verses.pickthall: And when the seas rise
verses.yusufAli: When the oceans boil over with a swell
verses.rodwell: And when the seas shall boil
verses.sale: and when the seas shall boil

verses.t: And when the souls are paired
verses.pickthall: And when souls are reunited
verses.yusufAli: When the souls are sorted out, (being joined, like with like)
verses.rodwell: And when souls shall be paired with their bodies
verses.sale: and when the souls shall be joined again to their bodies

verses.t: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
verses.pickthall: And when the girl-child that was buried alive is asked
verses.yusufAli: When the female (infant), buried alive, is questioned
verses.rodwell: And when the female child that had been buried alive shall be asked
verses.sale: and when the girl who hath been buried alive shall be asked

verses.t: For what sin she was killed
verses.pickthall: For what sin she was slain
verses.yusufAli: For what crime she was killed
verses.rodwell: For what crime she was put to death
verses.sale: for what crime she was put to death

verses.t: And when the pages are made public
verses.pickthall: And when the pages are laid open
verses.yusufAli: When the scrolls are laid open
verses.rodwell: And when the leaves of the Book shall be unrolled
verses.sale: and when the books shall be laid open

verses.t: And when the sky is stripped away
verses.pickthall: And when the sky is torn away
verses.yusufAli: When the world on High is unveiled
verses.rodwell: And when the Heaven shall be stripped away
verses.sale: and when the heaven shall be removed

verses.t: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
verses.pickthall: And when hell is lighted
verses.yusufAli: When the Blazing Fire is kindled to fierce heat
verses.rodwell: And when Hell shall be made to blaze
verses.sale: and when hell shall burn fiercely

verses.t: And when Paradise is brought near
verses.pickthall: And when the Garden is brought nigh
verses.yusufAli: And when the Garden is brought near
verses.rodwell: And when Paradise shall be brought near
verses.sale: and when paradise shall be brought near

verses.t: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it]
verses.pickthall: (Then) every soul will know what it hath made ready
verses.yusufAli: (Then) shall each soul know what it has put forward
verses.rodwell: Every soul shall know what it hath produced
verses.sale: Every soul shall know what it hath wrought

verses.t: So I swear by the retreating stars
verses.pickthall: Oh, but I call to witness the planets
verses.yusufAli: So verily I call to witness the planets - that recede
verses.rodwell: It needs not that I swear by the stars of retrograde motions
verses.sale: Verily I swear by the stars which are retrograde

verses.t: Those that run [their courses] and disappear
verses.pickthall: The stars which rise and set
verses.yusufAli: Go straight, or hide
verses.rodwell: Which move swiftly and hide themselves away
verses.sale: which move swiftly, and which hide themselves

verses.t: And by the night as it closes in
verses.pickthall: And the close of night
verses.yusufAli: And the Night as it dissipates
verses.rodwell: And by the night when it cometh darkening on
verses.sale: and by the night, when it cometh on

verses.t: And by the dawn when it breathes
verses.pickthall: And the breath of morning
verses.yusufAli: And the Dawn as it breathes away the darkness
verses.rodwell: And by the dawn when it brighteneth
verses.sale: and by the morning, when it appeareth

verses.t: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger
verses.pickthall: That this is in truth the word of an honoured messenger
verses.yusufAli: Verily this is the word of a most honourable Messenger
verses.rodwell: That this is the word of an illustrious Messenger
verses.sale: that these are the words of an honourable messenger

verses.t: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position]
verses.pickthall: Mighty, established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne
verses.yusufAli: Endued with Power, with rank before the Lord of the Throne
verses.rodwell: Endued with power, having influence with the Lord of the Throne
verses.sale: endued with strengeth, of established dignity in the sight of the possessor of the throne

verses.t: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy
verses.pickthall: (One) to be obeyed, and trustworthy
verses.yusufAli: With authority there, (and) faithful to his trust
verses.rodwell: Obeyed there by Angels, faithful to his trust
verses.sale: obeyed by the angels under his authority, and faithful

verses.t: And your companion is not [at all] mad
verses.pickthall: And your comrade is not mad
verses.yusufAli: And (O people!) your companion is not one possessed
verses.rodwell: And your compatriot is not one possessed by djinn
verses.sale: And your companion Mohammed is not distracted

verses.t: And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon
verses.pickthall: Surely he beheld Him on the clear horizon
verses.yusufAli: And without doubt he saw him in the clear horizon
verses.rodwell: For he saw him in the clear horizon
verses.sale: He had already seen him in the clear horizon

verses.t: And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen
verses.pickthall: And he is not avid of the Unseen
verses.yusufAli: Neither doth he withhold grudgingly a knowledge of the Unseen
verses.rodwell: Nor doth he grapple with heaven's secrets
verses.sale: And he suspected not the secrets revealed unto him

verses.t: And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens]
verses.pickthall: Nor is this the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned
verses.yusufAli: Nor is it the word of an evil spirit accursed
verses.rodwell: Nor doth he teach the doctrine of a cursed Satan
verses.sale: Neither are these the words of an accursed devil

verses.t: So where are you going
verses.pickthall: Whither then go ye
verses.yusufAli: When whither go ye
verses.rodwell: Whither then are ye going
verses.sale: Whither, therefore, are ye going

verses.t: It is not except a reminder to the worlds
verses.pickthall: This is naught else than a reminder unto creation
verses.yusufAli: Verily this is no less than a Message to (all) the Worlds
verses.rodwell: Verily, this is no other than a warning to all creatures
verses.sale: This is no other than an admonition unto all creatures

verses.t: For whoever wills among you to take a right course
verses.pickthall: Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight
verses.yusufAli: (With profit) to whoever among you wills to go straight
verses.rodwell: To him among you who willeth to walk in a straight path
verses.sale: unto him among you who shall be willing to walk uprightly

verses.t: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds
verses.pickthall: And ye will not, unless (it be) that Allah willeth, the Lord of Creation
verses.yusufAli: But ye shall not will except as Allah wills,- the Cherisher of the Worlds
verses.rodwell: But will it ye shall not, unless as God willeth it, the Lord of the worlds
verses.sale: But ye shall not will, unless God willeth, the Lord of all creatures
